title: Delphi and Consensus Methods — When Experts Must Agree

hook.en: For many questions in physiotherapy there is no trial, and experts disagree. A Delphi study asks a panel to rate and re-rate statements until they converge, which turns scattered opinion into structured agreement. It is not proof, but it is far better than the loudest voice winning.
hook.ur: Physiotherapy ke bohat se sawalon ke liye trial nahi, aur experts mutafiq nahi. Delphi study panel se bayanat ko rate aur dobara rate karwati hai jab tak woh qareeb na aa jayein, jo bikhri hui raye ko munazzam ittefaq mein badalti hai. Yeh saboot nahi, lekin sab se unchi awaaz ke jeetne se kahin behtar hai.

goal.en: By the end, you'll explain how a Delphi study runs, pick a panel and a consensus rule, avoid common traps, and say what consensus does and does not show.
goal.ur: End tak aap samjhayenge ke Delphi study kaise chalti hai, panel aur consensus ka qaida chunenge, aam jaalon se bachenge, aur batayenge ke consensus kya dikhata hai aur kya nahi.

text.en: A **Delphi study** collects opinions from a panel of experts in **several anonymous rounds**. After each round, the group's results are fed back, and members may revise their answers. The process stops when a **pre-set level of agreement** is reached, for example 75 or 80 percent rating a statement as important. Anonymity prevents dominant personalities steering the group; feedback lets people learn from each other. **Nominal group technique** and **consensus conferences** are related methods that use meetings.
text.ur: **Delphi study** experts ke panel se raaye **kai gumnaam daur** mein jama karti hai. Har daur ke baad group ke nateeje wapas diye jate hain, aur ahl-e-panel jawab badal sakte hain. Amal tab rukta hai jab **pehle se tay shuda ittefaq ki satah** pohanch jaye, masalan 75 ya 80 fisad bayan ko ahem rate karein. Gumnaami hawi shakhsiyaat ko group ko chalane se rokti hai; feedback logon ko ek doosre se seekhne deta hai. **Nominal group technique** aur **consensus conferences** milte julte tareeqe hain jo mulaqaton ka istemal karte hain.

text.en: Think of **a group of friends choosing where to eat**. If one loud person speaks first, everyone agrees. If each writes a choice on paper, the group reads the results, and then votes again, the final choice reflects everyone more fairly. Delphi is that written, repeated vote with feedback.
text.ur: **Doston ka group khane ki jagah chunta hai** sochein. Agar ek zor se bolne wala pehle bole to sab maan lete hain. Agar har ek kaagaz par chunao likhe, group nateeje parhe, aur phir dobara vote kare to aakhri chunao sab ki zyada munsifana numaindagi karta hai. Delphi woh likhi, dohrayi hui vote hai feedback ke saath.

steps.title: Define the question and gather statements
steps.detail: Use a literature review or a first open round to create a list of statements, such as possible core outcomes or recommended steps. || Sawal tay karein aur bayanat jama karein

steps.title: Choose the panel
steps.detail: Include 15 to 30 people with relevant experience: clinicians, researchers and, where appropriate, patients. Report how they were chosen. || Panel chunein

steps.title: Fix the consensus rule beforehand
steps.detail: For example "at least 75 percent rate it 7 to 9 on a 9-point scale". Deciding after seeing results invites bias. || Consensus ka qaida pehle tay karein

steps.title: Run rounds with feedback
steps.detail: In each round, panellists rate items anonymously, see the group's distribution and may change their rating. Two or three rounds are typical. || Feedback ke saath daur chalayein

steps.title: Report fully
steps.detail: State the panel, response rates per round, rules, final agreed items and those that failed to reach agreement. || Mukammal report dein

question.ur: Delphi ke daur gumnaam kyun hote hain?

text.en: Because experts do not wish to be named in the paper
text.ur: Kyunke experts paper mein naam nahi chahte

text.en: So that the results cannot be published
text.ur: Taake nateeje shaya na ho sakein

feedback.ur: Gumnaami panel ke andar hoti hai.

text.en: So that senior or dominant people do not sway others, and each member answers freely
text.ur: Taake senior ya hawi log doosron ko mutasir na karein, aur har ahl-e-panel azadi se jawab de

feedback.en: Yes — anonymity reduces the influence of status.
feedback.ur: Haan — gumnaami rutbe ka asar kam karti hai.

question.en: The researchers decide, after round two, that 60 percent agreement will count as consensus because 75 percent was too hard to reach. What is the problem?
question.ur: Muhaqqiq dosre daur ke baad tay karte hain ke 60 fisad ittefaq consensus mana jayega kyunke 75 fisad bohat mushkil tha. Masla kya hai?

feedback.en: Panel size is not the issue here.
feedback.ur: Yahan panel ka size masla nahi.

text.en: Nothing, flexible rules are good practice
text.ur: Kuch nahi, lachakdar qaide achhi practice hain

feedback.ur: Qaide pehle se tay hone chahiye.

text.en: Changing the rule after seeing the results introduces bias; the threshold should be fixed in advance
text.ur: Nateeje dekhne ke baad qaida badalna bias lata hai; had pehle se tay honi chahiye

feedback.ur: Haan — pehle se tay karna hera-pheri se rokta hai.

question.en: What does a Delphi consensus show?

text.en: That a group of experts agrees, which is useful when evidence is lacking, but it is not proof that the opinion is correct
text.ur: Ke experts ka group mutafiq hai, jo saboot ki kami mein mufeed hai, lekin yeh sabit nahi ke raye durust hai

feedback.en: Yes — agreement is not the same as truth.
feedback.ur: Haan — ittefaq aur sachai ek cheez nahi.

text.ur: Ke randomised trials ki zaroorat nahi

feedback.en: Consensus may point to trials that are needed.
feedback.ur: Consensus un trials ki taraf ishara kar sakta hai jo chahiye.

text.en: **Treating a consensus as a fact.** Experts can agree and still be wrong, and a panel made of people from one school of thought will agree on that school's ideas. Choose a diverse panel (and include patients where relevant), report disagreement as well as agreement, and treat consensus as the best available guide when evidence is missing, not a replacement for evidence.
text.ur: **Consensus ko haqeeqat samajhna.** Experts mutafiq ho kar bhi ghalat ho sakte hain, aur ek hi nazariye ke logon ka panel usi nazariye ke khayalat par mutafiq hoga. Mukhtalif panel chunein (mutaliq ho to mareez bhi), ittefaq ke saath ikhtilaf bhi report karein, aur consensus ko saboot na hone par behtareen dastiyab rehnumai samjhein, saboot ka badal nahi.

text.en: **Use a mini-consensus in your own team.** When your clinic cannot agree on a pathway, have each person write their view anonymously on a card, share the group results and vote again. It takes 20 minutes and avoids the dominance of the most senior or the loudest voice.
text.ur: **Apni team mein chhota consensus istemal karein.** Jab clinic kisi raaste par mutafiq na ho to har shakhs apni raye gumnaam card par likhe, group ke nateeje share karein aur dobara vote karein. Yeh 20 minute leta hai aur sab se senior ya sab se unchi awaaz ke ghalbe se bachata hai.

question.en: How are core outcome sets and clinical guidelines connected to Delphi?
question.ur: Core outcome sets aur clinical guidelines ka Delphi se kya talluq hai?

answer.en: Many core outcome sets, the lists of outcomes that every trial in a condition should measure, are developed using Delphi methods, often with patients. Guidelines also use consensus methods to turn evidence into recommendations when the evidence is incomplete. Knowing how a Delphi works helps you judge whether such lists are trustworthy.
answer.ur: Bohat se core outcome sets, yaani un nateejon ki list jo kisi halat ke har trial ko naapni chahiye, Delphi tareeqon se banaye jate hain, aksar mareezon ke saath. Guidelines bhi consensus tareeqe istemal karte hain jab saboot adhoora ho taake saboot ko sifarishat mein badla ja sake. Delphi kaise kaam karta hai yeh jaanna aap ko parkhne mein madad deta hai ke aisi lists bharosemand hain ya nahi.

beats.patient: A group of researchers wants to agree on what a "successful outcome" is after a shoulder replacement. There are many studies using different measures.
beats.assessment: There is no single answer and experts differ, so a Delphi study is suitable.
beats.treatment: They invite 25 surgeons, physiotherapists and patients, run three rounds with a 75 percent threshold, and report the final list of five outcomes plus the items that did not reach agreement.
beats.reassess: Future trials can measure the same five outcomes, which makes results easier to compare.

text.en: **Consensus on safety needs extra care.** A panel may agree that a technique is "safe enough" without good data. Treat such statements as provisional, include a safety expert on the panel and record dissent. For high-risk techniques, prefer cautious recommendations.
text.ur: **Safety par consensus ko mazeed ehtiyat chahiye.** Panel mutafiq ho sakta hai ke technique "kaafi mehfooz" hai bina achhe data ke. Aise bayanat ko waqti samjhein, panel mein safety ka maahir shamil karein aur ikhtilaf record karein. Zyada khatre wali techniques ke liye ehtiyat wali sifarishat ko tarjeeh dein.

text.en: A systematic review of Delphi studies found wide variation in how consensus was defined, with thresholds from about 50 to 80 percent, and recommended that authors pre-specify the consensus criterion and report the panel's response rates. The CREDES guidance sets out recommendations for conducting and reporting Delphi studies, including careful selection of panellists, clear description of rounds and feedback, and reporting of how results were used.
text.ur: Delphi studies ke ek systematic review ne paya ke consensus ki tareef mein bohat farq tha, thresholds takreeban 50 se 80 fisad tak, aur tajweez di ke musannif consensus ka criterion pehle se tay karein aur panel ki response rates report karein. CREDES rehnumai Delphi studies chalane aur report karne ki sifarishat deti hai, jis mein ahl-e-panel ka ehtiyat se intikhab, daur aur feedback ki saaf tafseel aur nateejon ke istemal ki report shamil hain.

text.en: **Panel, Anonymous rounds, Rule fixed, Report all.** Choose the panel, keep rounds anonymous, fix the consensus rule beforehand and report everything.
text.ur: **Panel, Gumnaam daur, Qaida tay, Sab report.** Panel chunein, daur gumnaam rakhein, consensus ka qaida pehle tay karein aur sab report karein.

summary.en: A Delphi study reaches structured agreement through anonymous rounds with feedback.
summary.ur: Delphi study feedback ke saath gumnaam daur se munazzam ittefaq tak pohanchti hai.

summary.en: Fix the consensus rule beforehand, pick a diverse panel and report disagreement.
summary.ur: Consensus ka qaida pehle tay karein, mukhtalif panel chunein aur ikhtilaf report karein.

summary.en: Consensus is a guide when evidence is lacking; it is not proof.
summary.ur: Saboot ki kami mein consensus rehnumai hai; saboot nahi.

back.en: Anonymous rounds of rating by experts with feedback until agreement.
back.ur: Experts ki gumnaam rating ke daur feedback ke saath ittefaq tak.

front.en: Why fix the consensus rule beforehand?
front.ur: Consensus ka qaida pehle kyun tay karein?

back.en: To prevent changing it after seeing the results.
back.ur: Nateeje dekhne ke baad badalne se rokne ke liye.

front.en: Does consensus prove an opinion is right?
front.ur: Kya consensus sabit karta hai ke raye durust hai?

back.en: No; it shows agreement, not truth.
back.ur: Nahi; yeh ittefaq dikhata hai, sachai nahi.

front.en: What is a core outcome set?

back.en: The outcomes every trial in a condition should measure.
back.ur: Woh nateeje jo kisi halat ke har trial ko naapne chahiyen.

note.ur: Expert ki raye kahan aati hai.
